messages:
June (Design): minor UX ask — run-history cards with tool calls show giant JSONs. can we surface a tiny structured preview instead of the raw blob?
Ravi (DevEx): yep. idea: show 2-3 top-level keys as 'key: value' rows, then a '+N' overflow pill. clicking the pill expands full payload. avoids scrolling horizontally.
Priya (PM): keep schema name and version visible on the header (so you know which fn/schema produced it). also a small indicator if the payload matched schema.
Noah (A11y): accessibility: collapsed preview must be keyboard focusable and announce "payload summary, 3 keys visible". expansion must toggle aria-expanded and focus the first code line.
June (Design): visual: tiny chevron to expand, separate 'Show full output' action on the card for power users. overflow pill has tooltip and is focusable.
Ravi (DevEx): implementation detail: avoid reparsing/serializing huge payloads on every render. we should store a compact summary (precomputed) on the invocation record. Pseudocode: 
```
invocation.summary = summarizeKeys(payload, 3)
```
Priya (PM): add a copy-summary button on the compact view (copy only the visible summary). also on errors show a subtle red badge and 'open trace' link.
Noah (A11y): copy button should use aria-live polite with message 'Summary copied'. ensure focus styles visible.
June (Design): microcopy proposals: expand/ collapse chevron labeled 'Expand payload' / 'Collapse payload'. card action label: 'Show full output'. overflow pill reads '+2 more'.
Ravi (DevEx): I'll spike a feature-flagged change using existing CodeBlock component with a collapsed preview renderer that accepts a schema prop for nicer key ordering.
ci-bot: CI started for feature/compact-run-preview (build 5284) :building_construction:
Ravi (DevEx): plan: spike -> demo in design sync -> small beta in dev sandbox. tagging @Noah for accessibility sign-off when PR is ready. :thumbsup:
